safety.mergeAuthority: The existing Product quality gate remains the only merge authority during phase 1.

notes: Fast is advisory and additive: dispatched Full and the composed merge-queue candidate retain every browser identity and the complete required gate.
The selected Infrastructure tests use unique temp/in-memory SQLite, except MigrationRegistrationTests which builds the Npgsql model against an invalid host without opening a connection.

SharedHostIsolationTests uses one disposable SharedApiHost/SQLite database with unique logical data and fresh clients to cover hosted startup, authentication/session isolation, persistence, and project authorization.

The explicit client manifest adds API-independent logic and rendered fixtures. Runtime discovery proves their identity parity with Full; every unknown file stays Full-only. Integrated browser smoke and its showcase seed remain in Full.

Rendered fixtures use Vite and Chromium only, reject API/external requests, and keep one worker with no retry. Individual assertions remain unchanged. Hosted latency and first-pass behavior must be measured before expanding this subset.
